goal: Build one refined, connected stock-trading application that can rival TradingView and thinkorswim. The autonomous agents choose and evolve its architecture and priorities.
architecture_reasoning: Supplied observations connect structural parsing to exact dataset preparation and owner-scoped Core validation. Chart consumption is a separate branch. Experiments now connect eligible datasets to the Core fixture engine through an ownership-pinned runner with a fully bounded, non-echoing request layer. Eligible dataset preparation hands its existing core_input to the experiment form in page memory. Chart overlay remains a separate planned connection because trade and equity geometry are not evidenced.

decisions: 2026-10-03 operator correction: the application itself is the product. product.html and disconnected calculators are prototypes, not completion of the mission.

Triad and Aegis independently consume Core. Triad chooses its own design and builds missing product tools and spaces. No Aegis dependency, broker credential grant, or live-trading authority is implied.

Dataset preparation is mounted at /triad/product-api/research/dataset-preparation. workspace to bar-inspector denotes CSV carried by the bounded triad.dataset-request.v1 through this endpoint; parsing precedes preparation.
Raw identity hashes exact submitted UTF-8. Prepared identity hashes schema_version, owner, metadata, window and rows as UTF-8 sorted-key compact JSON with ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False.

The unchanged inspector removes leading BOM, trims cells and headers, normalizes UTC, preserves decimal strings and sorts timestamp then symbol. No gaps filled or rows dropped. Metadata timestamps normalize to UTC; other metadata remains verbatim. Floats occur only at the Core boundary and for chart geometry.
Market declarations require strict caller confirmation before Core validation. Ineligible structural rows remain chartable without Core export.
Mode and provenance are caller supplied, not certified. No persistence, backtest-track-record or execution claims. Independent QA required before merge.
Cost and submitted-ledger tools remain available and independent until a simulated-result contract exists.
Named dataset unit and Chromium checks passed against candidate-local HTML and mounted API with the installed Core SDK. TESTED records development evidence, not independent QA or merge approval.

/triad/product-api/research/experiment is mounted at the product app; it calls preflight(core_input) (ownership plus Core quality eligibility) strictly before constructing any Experiment, then run_experiment builds a fixed fixture-conformance Experiment from the preflight-returned ResearchInput only. Only period, hold, directions, fees and slippage are caller-supplied request fields.

ExperimentRequest enforces distinct directions and 1<=hold<period<=1000 at the request-model layer, mirroring Experiment.validate_windows exactly, so malformed request shapes receive a bounded non-echoing 422 before any engine call, while a post-preflight construction or engine failure remains an uncaught 500.

The in-page dataset-preparation to experiments handoff copies the existing eligible core_input object and shows its prepared SHA-256 (core_input.dataset_id). It does not invent equity-curve, fill, or price geometry. Experiments to chart-workspace stays PLANNED and is not TESTED. Refresh drops the handoff because persistence is not granted.
